previous_statement: For each equivalence class C from node #1, choose a base index o and normalized v_i in p_i B p_o, with v_o=p_o. Put e_ij=v_i v_j*. Orthogonality of the p_i gives v_j* v_k=delta_jk p_o, so e_ij*=e_ji and e_ij e_kl=delta_jk e_il. Node #1 says p_i B p_j is zero for indices in different classes and is spanned by e_ij within one class. Since 1=sum_i p_i, every b in B equals sum_{i,j} p_i b p_j. Therefore B is the internal direct sum over C of span{e_ij:i,j in C}, and the displayed matrix units give a unital *-isomorphism B congruent to direct_sum_C M_{|C|}. This derives the finite-dimensional decomposition from the C*-algebra axioms and finite dimensionality rather than importing it.
